claims.claim: Provide personal-productivity space with limits, shared team environments and managed production environments
Unrestricted default environment sprawl is the common failure mode.

coverage: I extracted every behavioural claim in the skill — all three body bullets (the environment types and their limits, DLP policies scoped by environment, who may create environments, and templates and training) plus the default-environment-sprawl gotcha — and checked each against both listed sources; the skill contains no commands, flags or numbers, and its title, goal and self-check lines are not product claims.
